itemUsage.en: Nyamu Yūtenji is the drummer of Ave Mujica and a renowned video-form content creator, aiming to make her debut as an actress.
itemUsage.zh: Ave Mujica鼓手祐天寺若麦，同时也是著名美妆博主，正以演员出道为目标。

itemDesc.en: A diligent hard worker, she will perform the most difficult music to stylish perfection.
itemDesc.zh: 她从没停止过练习，不管曲子的难度有多大，她的演奏一定帅气完美。

description.en:
Operator Nyamu Yūtenji has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude for close-quarters combat and inflicting Physical damage over a wide area in coordination with fellow members of Ave Mujica.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Guard Operator during field operations to exercise Earthshaker responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
干员祐天寺若麦擅长与Ave Mujica的成员协作配合，进行近距离作战并造成大范围物理伤害
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为近卫干员，行使撼地者职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en: Nyamu is at Goldenglow's salon, doing makeup for a little child. 'Just a little blush, and you've got a natural shine to make the sun jealous! You're looking great!' 'Thank you, Miss Nyamu! When my stone disease is better, do you think I can become as pretty as you?' 'Of course you can! And I'll do your makeup even cuter for you then.' 'How about, you become my teacher then! And, and I want you to teach me how to play the drums all cool as well!' The child moved her limbs about, mimicking Nyamu's playing. 'Ooh, I'm a strict teacher. You sure you're ready?' Nyamu grinned. 'But first you heal up, then you can work on your skills, capiche?' 'Capiche! I'm gonna listen to everything the doctors say! Mom says if I do that, I'm sure to get better!' 'Good, good, there's a good kid. Listen, my name? It's 'Nyamu', which means 'young wheat'. See, wheat always grows stronger even when trampled on. If you wanna be my apprentice, you've gotta promise never to give up, just like me.' 'I promise! Okay, I've gotta go now! Miss Nyamu, Miss Goldenglow, bye-bye!' Rhodes Island was host to plenty of young, carefree children like her. For them, getting prettied up by Goldenglow and Nyamu was a form of bragging rights. 'You're incredible, Nyamu. You can play the drums, you can do makeup... I can't help but be in awe. How did you learn to do so many things?' 'How, huh...? I look at all the talent around me and I'm like, I wanna work harder to catch up to them! Also, if we're playing the compliments game, your hairdressing skills are out of this world!' 'Y-You're just saying that! I've still got so much to learn...' Goldenglow replies with a chuckle, before adding on. 'Also, Nyamu, I've got to say, you're really good with children.' 'Yeah, thank the brats in the family. My big brothers and sisters used to care for me a lot when I was little, then I took over to look after my li'l sibs.' 'Me too! I guess we've both got heaps of siblings in the family!' 'Ahahah, no kidding. But yeah, I think that's why I'm pretty good at handling kids now.' Hearing those words, Goldenglow smiles and doesn't respond. Nyamu, for her part, looks perplexed at the reaction. 'Hmm? Something funny about that?' 'No, no. It's just... I wouldn't call it 'handling' kids.' Goldenglow pauses, then adds. 'I mean, you should see how you look while you're talking to the kids. You treat them with genuine care.' Nyamu looks away, a touch embarrassed, and doesn't have anything to say for a while after that. All the while, Goldenglow returns to cleaning up the salon, smile still on her face.
description.zh:
在澄闪的小店里，若麦帮助孩子化好了简单的妆。
“嗯嗯，只要这样稍微涂点腮红，气色就能好很多，看起来活泼又自然啦！不错不错！”
“谢谢若麦姐姐！以后我石头病好了，长大了也能像若麦姐姐这么美吗？”
“那当然，那个时候姐姐继续给你化好看的妆！”
“那我也要拜若麦姐姐为师！我也要学打帅气的鼓！”小孩子手舞足蹈地学若麦的动作。
“学鼓那可得花上大量的时间，你可得做好心理准备哦。”若麦开心地说道，“我的要求可严格了，快先把病养好了再说吧！”
“好的！我一定听医生的话，妈妈说只要这样就能好得快了！”
“说得对！‘若麦’的意思是，年轻的麦子，不管遇到什么困难都不会低下头。既然要做我的徒弟，那就像我一样努力吧！”
“好的！那我走了！拜拜若麦姐姐！澄闪姐姐也再见！”
罗德岛上不乏这样天真的孩子，她们总喜欢来找澄闪姐姐和若麦姐姐，拜托她们帮自己打扮得美美的，去找其他孩子炫耀。
“若麦小姐真厉害，感觉擅长好多好多事情。既会打一手帅气的鼓，还有一手精湛的化妆技术，太羡慕了！若麦小姐都是如何学会这么多本事的？”
“嗯嗯……我只不过是努力想要赶上身边的天才们，就稍微花了些精力而已啦！而且，小澄闪的理发技术才厉害的吧！”
“那可没有！我还差得远呢！”澄闪苦笑道。
“而且我一直都想说，若麦小姐真的很擅长和孩子们打交道。”澄闪笑着补充道。
“只是因为我故乡的家里孩子比较多吧，从小哥哥姐姐照顾我，大一点了之后我会照顾更小的妹妹们。”
“原来若麦小姐也跟我一样，家里有这么多兄弟姐妹的吗！”
“所以我才会比较擅长应付小孩子吧哈哈。”
澄闪听了若麦的话，只是笑笑，若麦感到有点不解。
“怎么了？有什么问题吗？”
“不是不是，我只是觉得，若麦小姐可不是在应付他们呢。”澄闪接着说，“你跟大家说话的时候，眼睛里一点敷衍都没有的。”
若麦害羞地把头扭到一边，好半天一句话都不说。澄闪笑着，继续整理理发店去了。
